{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for the two channels of interest
channel_subset = sales[sales['channel'].isin(['email', 'paid_search'])]

# Check if the two channels are comparable across other variables (e.g., customer_segment, customer_age)
# Cross-tabulate channel vs. customer_segment
print("Cross-tabulation: channel vs customer_segment")
print(pd.crosstab(channel_subset['channel'], channel_subset['customer_segment']))

# Cross-tabulate channel vs. customer_age (check distribution)
print("\nCross-tabulation: channel vs customer_age (grouped into bands)")
# Create age bands
age_bins = [0, 25, 35, 50, 100]
age_labels = ['0-25', '26-35', '36-50', '51+']
channel_subset['age_group'] = pd.cut(channel_subset['customer_age'], bins=age_bins, labels=age_labels, include_lowest=True)
print(pd.crosstab(channel_subset['channel'], channel_subset['age_group']))"}
